description: This file defines a custom TextView component named LogView for Android applications, implementing log display functionality by formatting and outputting log data received via the LogNode interface. It manages chaining with other LogNode instances and includes methods for log message formatting and thread-safe UI updating.

classes.description: A custom TextView used for displaying log information received via the LogNode interface, including functionality for formatting log messages, managing log chaining, and ensuring thread-safe UI updates.
